opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not state their own name, so the opening is incomplete.

resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return reaching the warehouse, and the agent quoted an incorrect and contradictory timeline (70 to 40 days) that does not match the 2 working days elapsed.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the it's paid.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred and no damaged-item, bank dispute, or voucher step applied, so no required step was missed.

communication.quote: Agent: I understand, is worrying when money is outstandin.

closing.quote: Agent: Is they're anything else I can help you with?
